idea: VoyaGreen is a mobile-first travel recommender that scores a destination's tourism pressure, suggests a lower-pressure alternative with a similar vibe when it's overcrowded, and builds a day-by-day itinerary from the traveler's interests and trip length.
who: Filipino tourists planning a local trip use it to pick a place that is as good as the famous one, without adding to the crowding and strain on it.
core: The pressure check and swap: pick a destination, see its tourism-pressure score with the indicators behind it, and get a greener alternative with a personalized itinerary.
demo: Pick Boracay, set 3 days and interests: beach, food, snorkeling
See Boracay's tourism-pressure score (High) with the indicators behind it, and a lower-pressure alternative with the same vibe
Tap the alternative: a 3-day itinerary built on those interests, with a side-by-side pressure comparison
pain: Every traveler gets sent to the same handful of famous spots, so those places get overcrowded and strained while the traveler never sees how much pressure their choice adds.
character: Kyla, a college student in Quezon City planning her barkada's summer trip, who books Boracay because it is the first thing every TikTok and travel site shows her
painPoints: Recommendations rank by popularity, price and distance — never by the pressure on the place
Sustainability data exists but is scattered, and nobody researches it before booking
Lesser-known places with the same vibe stay invisible
hook: Kyla has three days, a barkada, and one question: where do we go? Every app she opens gives her the same answer — the place everyone else is already going.
closer: VoyaGreen doesn't tell travelers to stay home — it shows them somewhere just as good that the crowd hasn't found yet. Travel greener, not less.
qa: Where does the pressure score come from? | For the demo it's a seeded model combining visitor density, carrying capacity, and environmental indicators per destination; the real version would pull tourism arrival and environmental data from public sources. ; Is the itinerary AI-generated? | In this MVP it is assembled from a curated set of activities matched to your interests and trip length — no live AI call, so it never fails on stage. ; What doesn't work yet? | Destination data is seeded for a handful of Philippine places, there is no booking, no accounts, and no live data feed — those are next. ; Won't this just move the crowd to the alternative? | That's why the score is live-updated in the full version — alternatives rotate as their own pressure rises, so we spread visitors instead of relocating the crowd.
pitch30: Travel apps send everyone to the same famous places, and those places pay for it. VoyaGreen checks a destination's tourism pressure before you book, and if it's overcrowded it recommends a lower-pressure place with the same vibe and builds your itinerary there. Same great trip, less strain on the places we love.
next: Live tourism and environmental data feeds
Crowd rotation so alternatives never become the next hotspot
